note: 757 -> 755, both in odoo/orm/components/storage.py where D and ANN are enforced: a module docstring added (-1 D100) and the undocumented search_rows removed (-1 D102). search_rows was a second, ad-hoc implementation of selection with its own operator table, called by nothing outside its own unit tests, and its NULL semantics diverged from both PostgreSQL and the domain layer ('n < 5' raised TypeError on an unset column instead of excluding the row). InMemoryBackend.search already selects through Domain._as_predicate, the parity-tested path. Command: ruff check odoo/ --no-cache --select D --statistics | awk '{s+=$1} END {print s+0}'
